socially constructed roles and expectations for men and women
the number of males in a population
questions.e: Sex is biological, whereas gender is the set of roles and expectations that society attaches to being male or female.

questions.q: The Beti Bachao Beti Padhao scheme was launched in 2015 from
questions.e: The scheme was launched at Panipat, Haryana, to address the declining child sex ratio and promote girls' education.

questions.q: The Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act was passed in ______.
questions.e: The POSH Act came in 2013 and gave legal force to the Vishaka guidelines of 1997. The 2005 Act deals with domestic violence.

questions.q: Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidyalayas (KGBV) are residential schools meant mainly for
o: all children at the university level
girls from disadvantaged sections in educationally backward blocks
questions.e: KGBVs provide residential schooling to girls from SC, ST, OBC, minority and BPL families, mainly in educationally backward blocks.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements.
I. Sex and gender are identical terms.
II. Gender roles are fixed by biology and do not vary across cultures.
Which of the above is/are correct?
questions.e: Sex is biological while gender is socially constructed, so the two differ. Gender roles vary across cultures and change over time.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT a way in which schools may reinforce gender stereotypes?
o: Textbooks showing women mostly as homemakers
Assigning cleaning duties to girls and sports to boys
Seating boys and girls in separate rows
Using gender-neutral examples and equal participation
questions.e: Gender-neutral examples and equal participation challenge stereotypes. The other practices reinforce fixed ideas about what boys and girls do.

questions.sub: National Policy for Empowerment of Women
questions.q: The National Policy for the Empowerment of Women was adopted in
questions.e: The policy was adopted in 2001, which was also declared Women's Empowerment Year.

questions.q: A teacher notices that boys dominate the use of computers in the lab while girls hesitate to take turns. The most appropriate response is to
o: let the boys continue, since they are more confident
form mixed groups, rotate hands-on turns and encourage girls to participate
move the girls to a separate lab permanently
ask the girls to only take notes
questions.e: A gender-inclusive classroom gives equal opportunity and encouragement to all learners. Rotating turns in mixed groups does this directly.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about NEP 2020.
I. It proposes a Gender Inclusion Fund.
II. The fund is meant for girls as well as transgender students.
Which of the above is/are correct?
questions.e: NEP 2020 sets up a Gender Inclusion Fund to help provide equitable quality education to all girls and transgender students.

questions.q: In a block there are 500 school-age girls, of whom 400 are enrolled, and 400 school-age boys, of whom 360 are enrolled. The Gender Parity Index (female rate ÷ male rate) is
questions.e: Girls' rate is 400/500 = 0.8 and boys' rate is 360/400 = 0.9. GPI = 0.8/0.9 = 8/9, which is below 1, so girls are disadvantaged.
